strategy.name: Balanced Auto-Invest Strategy — Expanded Universe
strategy.description: Monthly dollar-cost averaging across 13 positions spanning blue-chip tech, AI infrastructure, defensive consumer, income ETFs, dividend growth, healthcare innovation, inflation hedges, and digital assets. Built for a couple investing $500–$1,000/month with a 10+ year horizon.
objectives: Long-term capital appreciation via blue-chip compounders
AI/technology growth exposure through multiple vectors
Monthly income generation via QQQI + SCHD dividends
Inflation and dollar hedge via gold, silver, and Bitcoin
Defensive ballast via consumer staples (WMT, COST)
Healthcare innovation via LLY and UNH
Broad diversification across sectors and asset classes

excluded_with_reason.META: Excellent AI ad business but high regulatory risk; watchlist for future addition
excluded_with_reason.TSLA: High volatility, inconsistent earnings; below 6.0/10 threshold
excluded_with_reason.TSM: Geopolitical Taiwan risk; NVDA captures chip demand more safely
excluded_with_reason.TGT: Losing market share to WMT/AMZN; below threshold
excluded_with_reason.JNJ: LLY and UNH provide better healthcare risk/reward; JNJ growth too slow
excluded_with_reason.ABBV: Humira patent cliff overhang; watchlist when Skyrizi/Rinvoq scaling is clearer
excluded_with_reason.PFE: Post-COVID revenue collapse, pipeline uncertain; avoid
excluded_with_reason.JPM: Strong bank but financials sector already implicit via SCHD
excluded_with_reason.V: Excellent moat; add consideration if portfolio grows beyond $50k
excluded_with_reason.BRK.B: Great but too similar to a diversified large-cap blend — SCHD fills that role more efficiently
excluded_with_reason.JEPI: Lower yield than QQQI with similar NAV risk; QQQI preferred for income role
excluded_with_reason.QQQ/VOO: Prefer individual high-conviction names over index for this strategy's purpose
excluded_with_reason.GLD: IAU identical exposure at lower expense ratio
excluded_with_reason.GDX: Miners add operating leverage risk not needed — IAU simpler
excluded_with_reason.FBTC: IBIT (BlackRock) preferred for liquidity and brand trust
excluded_with_reason.O: REIT distributions are ordinary income (less tax-efficient); watchlist

analysis.bull_case: Copilot integration across all M365 products = $10–20B incremental revenue by FY2028; Azure gaining enterprise AI workloads from on-premise migration.
analysis.bear_case: ~32x forward P/E is premium — AI monetization timeline risk; FTC/antitrust scrutiny on Activision integration.
analysis.note: User's stated favorite. Cornerstone holding — highest confidence in 10-year compounding.

analysis.bull_case: AI model training + inference demand grows 5–10x over 5 years; NVIDIA is the only viable supplier at scale. Blackwell architecture extends the CUDA moat.
analysis.bear_case: Valuation is richly priced; AMD/Intel closing gap; US export restrictions to China limit TAM; customer concentration (hyperscalers).
analysis.note: The defining AI infrastructure play. 10% allocation reflects high conviction but also elevated valuation risk.

moat_sources: Services (App Store, Apple Pay, Apple TV+, iCloud)
analysis.bull_case: Apple Intelligence (on-device AI) drives the most powerful iPhone upgrade cycle since 5G; Services revenue becoming majority of profits.
analysis.bear_case: China revenue risk (~18% of revenue); App Store antitrust pressure; iPhone hardware plateauing as upgrade cycles lengthen.

analysis.bull_case: AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker) capturing enterprise AI workloads; advertising growing 20%+; Prime membership expansion globally.
analysis.bear_case: AWS faces competition from MSFT Azure + GCP; regulatory/antitrust risk; retail business thin margins drag earnings.
analysis.note: No dividend but return via buybacks and growth. Consider enabling fractional share auto-invest.

analysis.bull_case: Walmart+ + advertising = Apple-like services pivot for retail; recession-proof, budget shoppers increase in slowdowns.
analysis.bear_case: Elevated P/E for a retailer; tariff headwinds on imported goods; Amazon competition relentless.

analysis.bull_case: GLP-1 obesity market is the largest drug category in history. Mounjaro + Zepbound are best-in-class with expanding indications (heart failure, sleep apnea, NASH). Pipeline is deep.
analysis.bear_case: Premium valuation (45–50x) is pricing in perfection; biosimilar risk after 2030; manufacturing bottlenecks limiting supply.
analysis.note: One of the most compelling long-term healthcare growth stories since the human genome project era. DCA reduces entry price risk given premium valuation.

analysis.bull_case: Counter-cyclical: budget-conscious consumers trade down to Costco in recessions. Membership fee price increase runway. International whitespace (Asia, Europe).
analysis.bear_case: Richly valued at 50x forward P/E — requires perfect execution. E-commerce transition slower than peers.
analysis.note: Complementary to WMT — both recession-resilient but Costco focuses on the club/bulk format with a stickier membership moat.

analysis.strategy: Writes index call options on NASDAQ-100 to generate monthly premium distributions
analysis.bull_case: 13–16% annual yield paid monthly is the cash engine of the portfolio. Distributions reinvested into conviction names (MSFT, NVDA) supercharge compounding.
analysis.bear_case: Caps upside vs. pure QQQ in a raging bull market; NAV erosion risk; distributions may include return of capital.
analysis.note: Do NOT DRIP. Reinvest distributions monthly into the most underweight position or highest-conviction name (MSFT/NVDA) for maximum compounding effect.

analysis.strategy: Tracks quality US companies with consistent dividend payments and growth; screens for FCF/debt, ROE, dividend growth
analysis.bull_case: Proven quality screen captures financially sound dividend growers. ~4% yield + 11% annual dividend growth = exceptional total return. Ultra-low 0.06% expense ratio.
analysis.bear_case: Value/dividend factor underperforms in high-growth bull markets; sector tilts toward energy/financials.
analysis.note: The 'boring but beautiful' backbone. 5-year dividend growth of 11% CAGR means yield-on-cost grows significantly over time. Complements QQQI perfectly.

drivers: Record central bank buying (2022–2026 multi-year trend)
analysis.backed_by: Physical gold held in JP Morgan vaults
analysis.bull_case: Structural central bank demand + de-dollarization = gold in a multi-year secular bull market. Portfolio insurance with zero counterparty risk.
analysis.bear_case: No yield — opportunity cost vs. bonds when real rates rise; speculative positioning could unwind.

drivers: Spot Bitcoin ETF approval (Jan 2024) — institutional floodgates opened
Store of value / digital gold narrative
analysis.bull_case: Post-halving supply shock + ETF institutional demand + potential sovereign adoption creates a multi-year structural appreciation case.
analysis.bear_case: 50–80% drawdowns are historically normal; regulatory risk; no fundamental cash flows; speculative dynamics.
analysis.position_cap: Do not exceed 10% of total portfolio
analysis.note: Reduced from prior 12% to 7% — Bitcoin remains speculative. IBIT is the cleanest, safest vehicle (BlackRock, lowest fees, most liquid).

moat_sources: Optum Health vertical integration (pharmacy + care delivery)
analysis.bull_case: DOJ investigation resolves; Medicare Advantage reimbursements stabilize; Optum grows independently. Wide moat at depressed P/E = value entry point.
analysis.bear_case: Regulatory overhang, DOJ forced breakup risk, congressional scrutiny, CEO transition uncertainty, MA margin compression.
analysis.upgrade_trigger: Increase to 10% if DOJ investigation closes favorably + two consecutive quarters of MA margin stabilization.
analysis.note: Reduced to 6% given elevated uncertainty. Wide moat still intact — thesis is 'wide moat at a discount.' DCA steadily rather than lump-sum.

drivers: Solar panel demand (2oz silver per panel, ~200GW/yr installs)
Historically elevated Gold/Silver ratio (mean reversion potential)
analysis.bull_case: Clean energy buildout creates structural industrial silver demand. Gold/Silver ratio at historic highs suggests silver is undervalued relative to gold. Mean reversion could deliver 30–50% outperformance.
analysis.bear_case: More volatile than gold (2x typical); industrial demand drops in recession; smaller market = more volatile price action.

auto_invest_schedule.method: Dollar-cost averaging (DCA) — buy every month regardless of price action

drip_settings.QQQI: DISABLE — reinvest distributions manually into MSFT or NVDA (most underweight)

rebalancing_rules.threshold: Rebalance any position drifting more than ±5% from target weight
rebalancing_rules.frequency: Review quarterly; rebalance if any breach detected
rebalancing_rules.method: Buy underweight positions with new contributions first — avoid selling to prevent taxable events
rebalancing_rules.bitcoin_cap: Never let IBIT exceed 10% of total portfolio
rebalancing_rules.msft_nvda_combined_cap: If MSFT+NVDA combined exceeds 30%, reduce new contribution to those two
rebalancing_rules.annual_review: Full strategy review every January — reassess UNH regulatory status, macro environment for gold/silver, and identify new candidates above 7.5/10 composite score

bear_market_minus_30pct.why_cushioned: WMT, COST, SCHD, IAU, SLV provide ballast. Gold typically appreciates in equity bear markets. DCA accelerates recovery.

inflation_surge.portfolio_response: IAU + SLV (13%) + IBIT (digital gold narrative) = 20% hard-asset exposure. COST and WMT can pass price increases.

ai_bubble_burst.portfolio_response: MSFT + NVDA + AAPL + AMZN combined = 38%. A 50% correction in those would cause ~19% portfolio drawdown — painful but not catastrophic.
ai_bubble_burst.defense: WMT, COST, SCHD, gold provide counter-cyclical protection

recession.portfolio_response: WMT, COST (counter-cyclical), SCHD (quality dividend payers), IAU (safe haven) total 35% defensive exposure.
recession.most_at_risk: LLY (high P/E multiple compression), NVDA (enterprise capex cuts)

thesis_break_exit_conditions.MSFT: Azure loses significant cloud market share to AWS/GCP OR AI Copilot monetization fails after 3 years
thesis_break_exit_conditions.NVDA: AMD achieves GPU parity + CUDA alternative gains widespread adoption OR China export bans eliminate >30% of revenue permanently
thesis_break_exit_conditions.AAPL: Structural iPhone market share collapse OR forced App Store breakup eliminates services revenue
thesis_break_exit_conditions.AMZN: AWS loses #1 cloud position AND retail market share collapses simultaneously
thesis_break_exit_conditions.WMT: Dividend cut OR sustained market share loss to AMZN + Target combined
thesis_break_exit_conditions.LLY: FDA withdraws GLP-1 drugs for safety concerns OR biosimilar competition eliminated pricing power before 2030
thesis_break_exit_conditions.COST: Membership renewal rate falls below 88% for two consecutive years
thesis_break_exit_conditions.QQQI: NAV declines persistently > 25% over 18 months with no recovery
thesis_break_exit_conditions.SCHD: Fund methodology change eliminates quality screen; expense ratio increase
thesis_break_exit_conditions.IAU: 30+ year deflationary environment (Japan-style) + sustained positive real rates
thesis_break_exit_conditions.IBIT: US government bans Bitcoin ETFs OR Bitcoin price falls >90% from peak and stays there 3+ years
thesis_break_exit_conditions.UNH: DOJ forces structural company breakup OR Congress bans Medicare Advantage business model
thesis_break_exit_conditions.SLV: Silver demand structurally replaced by alternative materials in solar/electronics

income_target.note: Income grows each year as more shares are accumulated
